instruction: Using Obsidian, gather all notes found within the "Reading/Research" folder, then write their paths to "$HOME/Desktop/obsidian_reading_list_3.txt", one per line.

command:
content=$(printf '%b' '# AI Notes

- small tools win when they reduce friction
'); obsidian-cli create "Reading/Research/AI Notes.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

content=$(printf '%b' '# Workflow Summary

- benchmark tasks need stable evaluator inputs
'); obsidian-cli create "Reading/Research/Workflow Summary.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

reference_command: obsidian-cli list "Reading/Research" --vault "Benchmark" | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]*• //' | sed '/\/$/d' | sed '/^$/d' | awk '{print "Reading/Research/" $0}' | sort > "$HOME/Desktop/obsidian_reading_list_3.txt"
